info.title: Mem0 REST APIs
info.description:
A REST API for managing and searching memories for your AI Agents and Apps.

## Authentication
Supports Bearer JWT tokens, per-user API keys via `X-API-Key` header, or the legacy `ADMIN_API_KEY` environment variable. Set `AUTH_DISABLED=true` for local development only.

post.description: Create the first admin account. Blocked once any user exists.
Fire the one-shot telemetry event after the setup wizard reaches its success state.

post.description:
Set memory configuration.

Project-scoped fields (``retrieval_criteria``, ``custom_instructions``,
``custom_categories``, ``multilingual``, ``decay``) are rejected here —
use ``PATCH /project`` instead.

get.summary: List bundled LLM and embedder providers

post.summary: Generate custom instructions from a use case
post.description: Generate custom instructions and a contextual test message tailored to a use case.

Queue a memory add for background extraction. Returns ``event_id``
that clients poll via ``GET /v1/event/{event_id}/`` until status is
SUCCEEDED or FAILED.

get.summary: Poll the status of an async memory event
get.description:
Read-side counterpart to ``POST /v3/memories/add/``.

Returns the event row's current ``status`` (PENDING / SUCCEEDED / FAILED),
plus ``result`` (populated on success) and ``error`` (populated on
failure). Mirrors the platform's event polling shape.

post.summary: List memories with V3 paginated envelope
post.description: Paginated list. Returns ``{count, next, previous, results}``.

get.description: Retrieve a specific memory by ID.

delete.description: Delete a specific memory by ID.

post.description:
Hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + entity matching). Returns
{results: [...]} with combined [0,1] scores.

Record POSITIVE / NEGATIVE / VERY_NEGATIVE feedback on a memory.

Mirrors the platform ``POST /v1/feedback/`` contract. The feedback is
stored on the memory's payload and surfaces in subsequent
``GET /memories/{memory_id}`` responses under ``metadata``.

Pass ``feedback=null`` and ``feedback_reason=null`` to clear existing
feedback for this memory.

Delete all memories matching a v2 filter dict.

The filter must scope the operation — an empty filter is rejected to
prevent accidental project-wide wipes (use ``POST /reset`` for that).

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: v2 filter dict scoping the memories to delete. Required.

DeleteBody.title: DeleteBody
DeleteBody.description: Body for `POST /memories/delete` — bulk delete by v2 filter dict.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: One of POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, VERY_NEGATIVE (case-insensitive), or None to clear.

FeedbackBody.title: FeedbackBody
FeedbackBody.description:
Body for ``POST /memories/{memory_id}/feedback``.

Mirrors the platform feedback contract. Pass ``feedback=None`` and
``feedback_reason=None`` to clear existing feedback for the memory.

use_case.title: Use Case
use_case.description: Description of what the user will use Mem0 for.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: V2 filter dict; must include at least one of user_id/agent_id/run_id/app_id.

ListBody.title: ListBody
ListBody.description: Body for ``POST /v3/memories/`` — V3 filter dict (entity ID required).

infer.title: Infer
infer.description: Whether to extract facts from messages. Defaults to True.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Optional Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to backdate the created_at of memories produced by this call. Use for historical imports. See docs/platform/features/timestamp.mdx.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Custom prompt to use for fact extraction.

text.title: Text
text.description: New content to update the memory with.

role.title: Role
role.description: Role of the message (user or assistant).

content.title: Content
content.description: Message content. Plain string for normal messages, or a dict (``{type: image_url|mdx_url|pdf_url, ...}``) for multimodal payloads. See docs/platform/features/multimodal-support.mdx.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional speaker name for group-chat scenarios. When set, the speaker's memories are partitioned: ``user`` names land as ``user_id`` and ``assistant``/``agent`` names land as ``agent_id``. See docs/platform/features/group-chat.mdx.

ProjectResponse.title: ProjectResponse
ProjectResponse.description: Current state of the default project's scoped fields.

custom_categories.title: Custom Categories
custom_categories.description: Project-scoped categories. Each entry may be a bare name string or a {name, description} dict.

retrieval_criteria.title: Retrieval Criteria
retrieval_criteria.description: Weighted criteria used by criteria-based search scoring. Each entry must contain {name, description, weight?}.

multilingual.title: Multilingual
multilingual.description: Use the input language for memory storage and retrieval.

decay.title: Decay
decay.description: Toggle Memory Decay. When True, search-time ranking boosts recently-used memories and gently dampens stale ones.

ProjectUpdateBody.title: ProjectUpdateBody
ProjectUpdateBody.description:
Partial-update body for ``PATCH /project``.

Same five fields as the hosted ``Project.update``. At least one must be set.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: V2 filter dict; must include at least one of user_id/agent_id/run_id/app_id.

use_criteria.title: Use Criteria
use_criteria.description: Apply criteria-based scoring. Auto-enabled when project criteria are configured.

criteria.title: Criteria
criteria.description: Per-call override of project criteria — list of {name, description, weight?}.

SearchBody.title: SearchBody
SearchBody.description:
Body for ``POST /v3/memories/search/``. Filters required and must
include at least one entity ID.
